title: Report FSLogix configuration and service health
summary: Reports FSLogix service state and selected non-secret configuration values useful for troubleshooting profile-container issues.

title: Test Azure Virtual Desktop image readiness
summary: Performs local checks commonly used before sealing an AVD image, including pending restart, BitLocker, profile, Teams and FSLogix indicators.

title: Audit Azure resource tag compliance
summary: Uses the Az module to report resources missing one or more required governance tags. No tenant or subscription value is embedded.

title: Create an Azure VM operational report
summary: Produces a generic VM inventory including power state, size, operating system and identity type using the Az module.

title: Test Azure Key Vault private connectivity
summary: Checks DNS resolution and TCP 443 reachability for supplied Key Vault DNS names without exposing any real vault names.

title: Collect Intune Management Extension diagnostics
summary: Collects service status, recent relevant event log entries and log-file metadata without copying tenant-specific log contents.

title: Audit Exchange Online connectors
summary: Reports inbound and outbound connector configuration after the administrator connects to Exchange Online.

title: Detect HP BIOS setup password state
summary: Checks whether the HP Client Management Script Library is present and reports only whether a setup password is configured; it never reads or exposes the password.

title: Detect Windows and Microsoft Edge Copilot configuration
summary: Intune detection script that checks Windows Copilot and Microsoft Edge Copilot-related policy values.

title: Detect a pending Windows restart
summary: Intune detection script for common component servicing, Windows Update and pending file rename restart indicators.

title: Disable Windows and Microsoft Edge Copilot
summary: Removes supported Copilot packages where present and applies machine/user policy settings for Windows and Microsoft Edge.

title: Set the Windows time zone
summary: Parameterised remediation for configuring a Windows time zone and validating the resulting setting.

title: Inventory Microsoft 365 application components
summary: Inventories selected Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive and WebView2 installation information from standard local sources.

title: Test the Teams Outlook add-in
summary: Checks common registry and installation indicators for the Microsoft Teams meeting add-in used by Outlook.

title: Audit Windows authenticated-scan prerequisites
summary: Audits services, firewall rules and administrative shares commonly required for authenticated Windows vulnerability scanning.

title: Test TCP and UDP connectivity
summary: Parameterised connectivity test suitable for Event Hubs, syslog, proxy or other endpoint validation without embedded organisation-specific addresses.

title: Validate private endpoint DNS resolution
summary: Resolves a supplied hostname, reports aliases and addresses, and optionally verifies that resolved addresses fall inside expected private CIDR prefixes.

title: Register startup and shutdown wrapper tasks
summary: Creates generic scheduled tasks for a startup script and an event-triggered shutdown wrapper. Paths are supplied as parameters.

title: Report Splunk Universal Forwarder health
summary: Reports service state, executable version where available and selected local configuration-file metadata without revealing configuration contents.

title: Report Microsoft Defender endpoint health
summary: Reports Defender service, antivirus status and selected preference values using built-in Defender cmdlets.

title: Validate a Defender indicator CSV
summary: Validates indicator type, value, action and severity fields before a CSV is used in an administrative import workflow.

title: Plan SharePoint file deletion from CSV
summary: Validates a CSV file list and defaults to dry-run behaviour. Actual deletion requires an explicit switch and an established PnP connection.

title: Audit Teams compliance recording configuration
summary: Reports Teams compliance recording policies and paired application metadata after connecting to Microsoft Teams.
